reworkHistory: Reset legacy Driver/Admin brand selectors that clipped the new ProductLogo.
Reset Admin navigation label sizing for Persian content.
Encoded Persian X-Purpose-Scope request header values for browser transport compatibility.
Strengthened narrow public copy wrapping and shared overlay keyboard focus behavior.
Aligned the Vite preview base with the production /app/ asset path.
Replaced tablet/mobile horizontal panel menus with reusable accessible hamburger drawers across Shipper, Company X, Company Y, Driver, Agent and Admin.

Rebuilt public onboarding and registration as true RTL layouts, replaced role artwork with two optimized generated logistics images, and corrected directional controls, registration steps, field labels and technical input direction.
Changed public driver and carrier role cards to enter the matching login page first; kept registration reachable through each login page's registration CTA.
Removed example placeholder text from driver and carrier registration inputs and eliminated the nested click-focus rectangle while keeping labels and icons clear.
Made the welcome header's RTL left/right alignment explicit and kept the security status pill visible beside the logo on narrow screens.

Replaced the previous user-facing Persian carrier terminology with شرکت حمل‌ونقل across public auth/registration, account, admin and registration feedback surfaces without changing carrier role or API identifiers.
Published the current frontend to the active IIS release and published the backend source with the 30-day refresh-token endpoint, preserving server configuration and retaining rollback backups.

Separated the public six-panel menu into role-specific entry paths and added a fail-closed client route guard that never renders the driver workspace for an unrelated role or missing organization session.
